description: The workspace's rooms: where groups of people work together with zv1 and flows. Returns each room's id, name, people and flows, linked folders, open sidebar count, and when it last moved. Use it to find the room a user means before rooms_read or rooms_post.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
